question: What auspicious quality is attributed to a fire-pit that is four-cornered on all sides?
premises: A fire-pit may be four-cornered on all sides.
Such a shape is being evaluated.
It is described as bringing auspiciousness.
inference: A fire-pit that is four-cornered on all sides is auspicious.
plain_english: This fire-pit, four-cornered on all sides, is indeed auspicious.
